*Sit up through the night beside Caddoc's biggest cage trap on the Strandwood Rocks, while the creatures come out of the trees. Potions work; scrolls do not.*

## 1. The Long Night

Map: [Caddoc's Trap, at Night](../maps/caddocs_trap_night.md)
